title: Deductible Rewards Credit Weighting on Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Total-Loss Settlements
content:
**Program term.** When Deductible Rewards credit is applied to the deductible charge of a total-loss vehicle surrendered under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage: on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Premier where the vehicle has earned at least one claim-free-year credit, each dollar of credit balance counts 1.25 dollars toward the deductible charge; on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Preferred where the vehicle has earned at least one claim-free-year credit, each dollar counts 1.1 dollars; otherwise each dollar counts one dollar. The weighted balance is rounded to the cent and applied up to the deductible charge.

The package is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record. A claim-free-year credit is a Deductible Rewards credit entry on the vehicle's coverage granted for a claim-free year; the enrollment credit is not one.

## Weight per dollar of credit balance

| Package | At least one claim-free-year credit earned on the vehicle | Each dollar of balance counts |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Premier | Yes | 1.25 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | No | 1 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | Yes | 1.1 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | No | 1 |
| Any other package | Either | 1 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- Premier policy, claim-free-year credit earned, balance 300.00, deductible charge 500.00: weighted balance 375.00, applied in full; 125.00 of the charge remains.
- Same, with balance 450.00: weighted balance 562.50, applied up to the charge of 500.00; nothing remains.
- Preferred policy, claim-free-year credit earned, balance 200.00: weighted balance 220.00.
- Premier policy whose only credit entry is the enrollment credit, balance 100.00: counts 100.00.
